prayerExcerpt.en-US: Eighty and six years have I served Him, and He never did me any injury.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Há oitenta e seis anos que o sirvo, e ele nunca me fez mal algum.

meta.face: A very old man of about eighty-five with a SMALL, HEART-SHAPED face: wide cheekbones tapering to a small pointed chin, round rosy apple cheeks, a small short upturned nose, small bright eyes crinkled by a gentle smile, a short upper lip; a full head of soft thin silvery-white hair falling to the nape (not bald); a short, neat, rounded snow-white beard; eyes raised to heaven with a quiet smile.
meta.basis: The Painter's Manual gives 'an old man, rounded beard', and the Martyrdom gives his age, eighty-six years in Christ's service, and the fire shaped 'like the sail of a ship'. The full white hair is an artistic choice to keep him apart from the bald elders on existing cards.
meta.excerpt: Martyrdom of Polycarp 9, ANF vol. 1 (1885); pt-BR our rendering
